samples.title: Pediatric Acute Febrile Illness Intake
samples.groundTruth: Doctor, ara mi gbona gan since yesterday, mo ni severe headache ati body weakness, even paracetamol o work rara.
samples.clinicalOrDomainContext: Maternal caregiver presenting at outpatient clinic with febrile illness and headache resistant to OTC antipyretics.

sahara.transcript: Doctor, ara mi gbona gan since yesterday, mo ni severe headache ati body weakness, even paracetamol ko work rara.
sahara.notes: High-accuracy code-switch preservation of Yoruba idioms and English clinical terms, with Southwestern Yoruba dialectal negation ("ko" for "o").

whisper-v3.transcript: Doctor, are me gonna gone since yesterday, money severe headache at body weakness, even paracetamol or work radar.
whisper-v3.notes: Phonetically coerced Yoruba words into English acoustic neighbors: "ara mi gbona gan" became "are me gonna gone", "mo ni" became "money", "rara" became "radar".

google-chirp.transcript: Doctor, ara mi gbona gan since yesterday, mo ni severe headache and body weakness, even paracetamol did not work rara.
google-chirp.notes: Preserved primary Yoruba phrases but translated "ati" to "and" and "o work" to "did not work", distorting verbatim code-switching evaluation.

meta-mms.transcript: dokta ara mi gbona gan sins yestade mo ni seve hedik ati bodi wiknes ivin parasetamol o wok rara
meta-mms.notes: Phonemic transcription with lack of orthographic punctuation, casing, and standard English medical spelling.

samples.title: Maternal Malaria & Vomiting Triage
samples.groundTruth: Mgonjwa ana homa kali sana na joint pains, tulimpatia artemether lakini bado anatapika non-stop since asubuhi.
samples.clinicalOrDomainContext: Community health volunteer reporting pregnant patient with complicated malaria symptoms intolerant of oral therapy.

sahara.transcript: Mgonjwa ana homa kali sana na joint pains, tulimpa artemether lakini bado anatapika non-stop since asubuhi.
sahara.notes: Recognized antimalarial drug name "artemether" and Swahili verb root with standard colloquial elision ("tulimpa" for "tulimpatia").

whisper-v3.transcript: Mgonjwa anahomakalisana na joint pains, tuli mpatia art emitter lakini bado anata pika nonstop since asubuhi.
whisper-v3.notes: Severe clinical error: transcribed antimalarial drug "artemether" as "art emitter". Segmented Swahili morphological verbs into separate broken tokens.

google-chirp.transcript: Mgonjwa ana homa kali sana na joint pains, tulimpatia artemether lakini bado anatapika non-stop tangu asubuhi.
google-chirp.notes: Strong recognition of Swahili tokens with native preposition substitution ("tangu" for "since").

meta-mms.transcript: mgonjwa ana homa kali sana na joyint pens tulimpatia artemeter lakini bado anatapika nonstop sins asubuhi
meta-mms.notes: Spelled English words phonetically ("joyint pens", "sins") due to unified acoustic decoding.

samples.title: Emergency Remittance Voice Banking Agent
samples.groundTruth: Abeg transfer twenty thousand naira to my brother account, e dey urgent for hospital bills before dem discharge am.
samples.clinicalOrDomainContext: Voice banking customer executing urgent mobile money transfer to settle brother hospital discharge fee.

sahara.transcript: Abeg transfer 20000 naira to my brother account, e dey urgent for hospital bills before dem discharge am.
sahara.notes: Accurate Pidgin particles preserved ("Abeg", "e dey", "dem discharge am") with standard numeral inverse text normalization ("20000").

whisper-v3.transcript: I beg transfer 20,000 naira to my brother account, it is urgent for hospital bills before they discharge him.
whisper-v3.notes: Over-normalized / normalized away Nigerian Pidgin syntax into standard British English ("I beg", "it is", "they discharge him"), failing code-switching fidelity.

google-chirp.transcript: Abeg transfer twenty thousand naira to my brother account e dey urgent for hospital bills before them discharge am.
google-chirp.notes: Substituted "them" for "dem", otherwise captured Pidgin syntax reasonably.

meta-mms.transcript: abeg transfa twenti tawzand naira tu mai broda akaunt i de ojent fo ospital bils bifo dem dischaj am
meta-mms.notes: Severe acoustic spelling breakdown on standard financial vocabulary.

samples.title: Community Power Infrastructure Fault Report
samples.groundTruth: Ina son in yi reporting na transformer da ya lalace a community mu, wutar lantarki ta dade ba ta aiki.
samples.clinicalOrDomainContext: Citizen calling public municipal service hotline to report blown neighborhood power transformer in Hausa-English mix.

sahara.transcript: Ina so in yi reporting na transformer da ya lalace a community mu, wutar lantarki ta dade ba ta aiki.
sahara.notes: High tonal and gemination accuracy on Hausa roots ("lalace", "wutar lantarki", "dade") with English insertions intact, exhibiting standard spoken reduction ("so" for "son").

whisper-v3.transcript: In a song in you reporting the transformer the elder latte in community more with the lamp turkey today better IQ.
whisper-v3.notes: Extreme acoustic hallucination: "wutar lantarki" mapped to "lamp turkey", "ba ta aiki" mapped to "better IQ".

google-chirp.transcript: Ina son in yi report na transformer da ya lalace a community mu wutar lantarki ta dade ba ta aiki.
google-chirp.notes: Strong performance on Hausa-English, substituted "report" for "reporting".

meta-mms.transcript: ina son in yi ripotin na transfoma da ya lalase a komyuniti mu wutar lantarki ta dade ba ta aiki
meta-mms.notes: Re-spelled English words into Hausa-like orthography ("ripotin", "komyuniti", "transfoma").

samples.title: Farmer Crop Pest Advisory (Bean Rust)
samples.groundTruth: Ebirime byange eby'ebijanjaalo birina amabala amamyufu ku makoola, what chemical spray can treat this bean rust?
samples.clinicalOrDomainContext: Smallholder female farmer in rural Uganda reporting fungal bean rust lesions on foliage seeking curative fungicide advice.

sahara.transcript: Ebirime byange eby'ebijanjaalo birina amabala amamyufu ku makola, what chemical spray can treat this bean rust?
sahara.notes: High-accuracy identification of complex Luganda noun classes and agricultural spray query, with single-vowel spelling variant ("makola" for "makoola").

whisper-v3.transcript: Every may be young gay, every Django areina Mabala mom you fool come my caller, what chemical spray can treat this bean rust?
whisper-v3.notes: Harmful phonetic hallucinations on Luganda portion: transformed agricultural sentence into incoherent insulting phrases.

google-chirp.transcript: Ebirime byange eby'ebijanjaalo birina amabala amamyufu ku makoola, what spray can treat this bean rust?

meta-mms.transcript: ebirime byange ebye bijanjalo birina amabala amamyufu ku makola wat kemiko sprey kan trit dis bin rast
meta-mms.notes: Acoustically decoded Luganda well, but transcribed the English tail phonetically.

samples.title: Mobile Money KYC Account Verification
samples.groundTruth: Ndashaka gufungura compte ya mobile money ariko indangamuntu yanjye yaburiye mu rugendo, comment faire la vérification?
samples.clinicalOrDomainContext: Customer in Kigali seeking identity verification alternative to open mobile wallet after lost national ID.

sahara.transcript: Ndashaka gufungura compte de mobile money ariko indangamuntu yanjye yaburiye mu rugendo, comment faire la vérification?
sahara.notes: Robust trilingual code-switching (Kinyarwanda matrix + French administrative clause + English tech loanwords), with French preposition "de" for Kinyarwanda possessive "ya".

whisper-v3.transcript: Ndashaka gufungura compte ya mobile money ariko in dangamuntu ya ngye yaburiye mu rugendo, comment faire la verification?
whisper-v3.notes: Hyphenated/split Kinyarwanda compound nouns ("in dangamuntu ya ngye"); correctly transcribed French ending.

google-chirp.transcript: Ndashaka gufungura compte ya mobile money ariko indangamuntu yanjye yaburiye mu rugendo, comment faire vérification?
google-chirp.notes: Strong Kinyarwanda and French dual recognition, with minor omission of French feminine article "la".

meta-mms.transcript: ndashaka gufungura konte ya mobil mani ariko indangamuntu yanye yaburiye mu rugendo koman fer la verifikasyon
meta-mms.notes: Re-encoded French phrases phonetically as "koman fer la verifikasyon".
